d:
Hi, this is just a quick post (I'll post more if it works!) of some images from my ongoing graphic novel "Decadent Wasteland". It is an ongoing learning curve, created over a number of years so the early book is a little rough around the edges, but I am getting better (I think.)

Anyway, wary of touting for subscribers, really just wanted some feedback on the artwork. You can find me on subscribe star adult under 'LimitReacher' as there are more previews on there. If you do visit, please drop me a message and let me know what you think of the art and any chances I could make to the page to improve it.

Much appreciated, thanks for looking.

Limit Reacher.
